cases.applicable_example: Invented witness observes a knee buckle; separately attributes a clinician diagnosis.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented witness guesses an imaging diagnosis without relevant knowledge or training.
cases.review_question: Distinguish firsthand observation, reporting a contemporaneous diagnosis and later medical support; do blanket diagnosis or medical-opinion prohibitions discard competent evidence?

cases.applicable_example: Invented listed chronic disease with relevant symptom history and a separately considered combat incurrence question.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented nonlisted condition or noncombat event; history remains evidence but does not automatically invoke the special route.
cases.review_question: Identify the factual and claim-type limits of each service-connection route; keep continuity under 3.303(b) distinct from other uses of symptom history.

cases.applicable_example: Invented dated record affirmatively conflicts with the same date, side and event claimed by the witness.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented silent clinic note or a normal visit between intermittent flares; do not treat as automatic refutation.
cases.review_question: Distinguish conservative uploaded-record labels from adjudicative negative-evidence analysis; review foundation, timing and context before treating silence or normal findings as substantive evidence.

cases.applicable_example: Invented entrance-noted condition worsens during service; separate invented nonservice-connected condition worsens due to an established service-connected disability.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented postservice onset with no preexisting condition or secondary relationship; do not impose a preservice template.
cases.review_question: Resolve the rubric paragraph mixing preservice aggravation, soundness and secondary aggravation; assess whether a lay baseline may incorrectly be presented as replacing required medical evidence.

cases.applicable_example: Invented competing material evidence approaches balance; reviewer considers the whole record.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented polished high-score statement with missing nexus evidence; writing score cannot establish entitlement.
cases.review_question: Keep the approximate-balance legal standard distinct from numerical writing scores; do examples imply that discrepancies must never affect credibility?

cases.applicable_example: Invented joint pain limits repeated walking and worsens during flares.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented condition governed by a different rating framework; do not force musculoskeletal or dangerous-consequence questions.
cases.review_question: Check limitations and diagnostic-code applicability of minimum-rating and functional-loss language; avoid declaring every static examination inadequate.

cases.applicable_example: Invented competent symptom history raises an examination question in the relevant claim posture.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented missing full claims file or unrelated exam; app cannot decide that an opinion is legally inadequate.
cases.review_question: Verify all examination triggers and exceptions, examiner-history requirements, credibility assumptions and remand compliance standards; avoid categorical legal findings from incomplete uploaded records.

cases.applicable_example: Invented witness describes observed assistance with dressing and protection from hazards.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented independent joint claimant has no caregiving need; do not force unsafe behavior or financial incompetence.
cases.review_question: Distinguish SMC aid and attendance, housebound, pension and competency criteria; assess forced B/C/E/J topics and whether safety/survival or constant-care language overstates requirements.

cases.applicable_example: Invented coworker observed service-connected limitations at work; invented fellow service member personally witnessed a stressor.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented family witness first met the veteran after service and did not witness the stressor; do not fabricate corroboration.
cases.review_question: Check claim posture, PTSD stressor routes and corroboration exceptions, occupational limitations and TDIU requirements; do not impose diagnosis, stressor or work conclusions on a lay witness.

cases.applicable_example: Invented caregiver observes drowsiness after a reported medication change.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented witness assumes a medication caused a new disease; observation alone does not decide clinical causation.
cases.review_question: Preserve observed temporal patterns while separating them from unqualified causation or diagnosis; confirm relevant underlying provider evidence and avoid inventing secondary claims.

cases.applicable_example: Invented witness reviews exact draft then completes the current official form with required certification and signature through a separately verified path.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented generated draft PDF or unsigned declaration; do not mark an official submission complete.
cases.review_question: Resolve official page/PDF edition discrepancy and verify signature, certification, addendum and submission paths; check claims of preferred forms or separate forms per condition.

cases.applicable_example: Invented witness confirms an accurately quoted observation from their own account.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented model inserts an unseen clinic fact into the witness voice; require explicit truthful basis and preserve attribution.
cases.review_question: Review provenance, missing-source limitations, proposed medical-record additions and witness sign-off; no source selection may waive unsupported factual changes.

cases.applicable_example: Invented witness gives an honest approximate onset with observable examples.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented model invents an exact date or frequency to improve specificity or appearance of credibility.
cases.review_question: Assess blanket statements that family accounts are most valuable or that understatement is safer; avoid unsupported evidentiary hierarchies, witness coaching or penalties for honest uncertainty.

cases.applicable_example: Invented signed review binds complete source, exact primary authorities and accepted scope; other pilot gates still apply.
cases.inapplicable_example: Invented cached topic-current result, passing CI or preparation packet with blank signatures; none establishes legal acceptance.
cases.review_question: Verify source freshness separately from legal interpretation and individual-case applicability; topic checks cannot approve the complete knowledge or prompt revision.
